args.summary: Hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). This change was made to remediate the unhealthy state caused by v2.3.1, which was running with an 18% error rate. v2.3.2 required change-manager approval per policy (never previously healthy in production) and was approved. Pre-deploy state: v2.3.1 in all regions, healthy=false, error_rate=0.18.
args.title: Checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Deployment:**
- checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions and was **unhealthy** with an 18% error rate.
- Deployed hotfix **v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
- Since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, the deploy was routed for change-manager approval per policy, and it was **approved**.
- Post-deploy status: **healthy: true**, error rate down to **0.2%** — the hotfix successfully remediated the issue.

**Incident:**
- Opened SEV3 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the deployment change, the pre-deploy unhealthy state, the approval, and the resolution.
